name: Town of Somers
gaps: No floor-area (FAR/GFA) cap for one-family homes in the Zoning Schedule; only a minimum livable floor area
No distinct corner-lot street-side yard found (§ 170-35 covers only sight triangles); corner_side_ft null
Lot depth not regulated; accessory front setback not numeric (accessory buildings simply may not be in the front yard)

DRD (Designed Residential Development, § 170-12) has no lot-by-lot yards: setbacks are from the development perimeter (50 ft) and roads (40 ft from Class A road right-of-way / 30 ft from Class B road center line); front_ft records the 40 ft figure, side/rear null
MFR-H site coverage is '--' in the schedule; MFR-BP is in the schedule but not in the county layer, so not included
eCode360 lists three uncodified 2025 zoning amendments (L.L. 1-2025, 4-2025, 6-2025) not yet in the text; not reviewed
Nonresidential districts not checked for one-family use

wetlands.summary: Ch. 167: wetland buffer extends 100 ft horizontally from the wetland boundary or watercourse bank (more where designated) and is regulated like the wetland; regulated activities need a wetland permit.

steep_slopes.summary: Ch. 148: permit to disturb 100+ sf of steep slopes, defined as areas of 10,000+ sf at 15% or more (moderate 15-25%, very steep 25-35%, extremely steep 35%+).

trees.summary: Ch. 156: permit to remove trees (12 in.+ dbh combined) in wetland/regulated buffers, within 30 ft of a scenic road center line, on very/extremely steep slopes, in the B-HP district or conservation land, or more than 2/4/6/8 trees a year in R-10/R-40/R-80/R-120.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 93: stormwater/erosion control rules apply to construction disturbing 5,000 sf or more or moving 50 cubic yards or more of soil.

adu.summary: § 170-70: accessory apartments by ZBA special exception permit, owner-occupied, normally on lots of 40,000 sf+ (accessory buildings only on 40,000 sf+), in buildings permitted before 4-1-1992; 300-800 sf, one bedroom; permit renewed every 7 years.

general.accessory_structures: Detached accessory buildings/structures (toolhouses, playhouses, pools, tennis courts, animal housing) may not be in the front yard and must meet the schedule's accessory side/rear distances: 15 ft in R-120/R-80/R-40, 5 ft in R-10; max 15 ft to roof midpoint (12 ft flat) (§ 170-11).
general.pools: Pools are accessory structures: not in the front yard; 15 ft from side/rear lot lines (5 ft in R-10) (§ 170-11B(8)). Pools count toward site coverage but not building coverage.
general.notes: New single-family lots must also meet the environmentally sensitive lands rules of §§ 170-58.3A and 170-58.4A (Article XA). Fences and walls max 6 ft (§ 170-49).

R-120.name: Residence R120

max_building_coverage.note: All buildings and impervious structures, excluding pools, carports and sheds; unenclosed porches count (§ 170-55)

max_impervious_coverage.note: Site coverage: all buildings, structures and impervious surfaces incl. driveways, pools, carports, patios and walkways

accessory.notes: Detached accessory buildings and structures (incl. pools, tennis courts, sheds) may not be in the front yard and must be 15 ft from side and rear lot lines (cols. 13-14, § 170-11B(8)); max 1.5 stories, 15 ft to roof midpoint or 12 ft for flat roofs (barns excepted). Attached accessory buildings follow principal rules (§ 170-53).

R-120.notes: Height is measured to the midpoint of a pitched roof (30 ft); minimum 1 story / 13 ft. Minimum livable floor area 2,000 sf per dwelling. Width is at the front lot line; Planning Board may cut frontage to 1/3 of the width on a turnaround if full width is met at the setback line (note 1). Front yard may be reduced to the average of adjoining dwellings (§ 170-48A). Buildings on a lot at least half the taller building's height apart, min 10 ft (note 2).

MFR-H.name: Multifamily Residence Hamlet MFR-H

accessory.notes: Accessory use 50 ft from side and rear lot lines; max 1.5 stories / 15 ft

MFR-H.notes: 10 acres per development, no minimum per unit. All buildings at least 75 ft from any street line and 100 ft from a line shared with a single-family residence district (note 3). Density and other standards in § 170-13.

DRD.name: Designed Residential Development

accessory.notes: Accessory structures 30 ft from the development perimeter, 20 ft from Class A road right-of-way / 20 ft from Class B road center line

DRD.notes: 500 contiguous acres per development (in R-120/R-80/R-40); at least 1/3 open space. Single-family detached homes: 50 ft from the development perimeter, 40 ft from a Class A road right-of-way, 30 ft from a Class B road center line; buildings at least half the taller building's height apart (min 10 ft); max 3 stories / 35 ft.
